author: ThioJoe
description:
They are going to destroy the last ember of privacy on the internet.

Governments are continuing their relentless march to ruin everything, this time forcing you to hand over your ID for the usual stupid reasons. In this video I talk about a few of the ways this is going to happen due to upcoming laws, such as app-store level age verification and operating system level age verification. This includes even iOS which rolled out a new system for just that. There's not really anything we can do about it at this point.
